number_semantics: Decimal strings are exact rationals; null is UNKNOWN, never zero.

accepted_input_sets.status: All exact published inputs; conditional, not physical qualification

scenario.memory: CY62167 internal 32+6+ERR candidate; architecture remains author's decision

environment_contract.quantity: upper full-word load nu, not the observed counter and not automatically the parent rate
environment_contract.entry_definition: first crossing of b_Q after D_Q of nu<=b_Q; entry ends at v_e; intraburst rebounds keep ongoing label until next qualified quiet prehistory
environment_contract.initial_intensity: free up to B; may begin in an ongoing burst
environment_contract.coverage: uniform conditional guarantee inside declared Lambda/Theta; no unconditional coverage probability assigned
environment_contract.data_status: T68 full38 accumulation response rounded outward, conditionally promoted to future bounds; T67 growth candidate is not a qualification

mark_contract.parents: exogenous marked NHPP; marks independent across parents; multiword marks allowed
mark_contract.position_law: time-invariant conditional bit-position distribution in each word, for non-SMU touches

whole_mission_quotas.initial_pending_write: excluded on the good initial event; qualification not claimed
whole_mission_quotas.fixed_competitor_quotas: rho0 + delta_exec + delta_svc; no unnecessary monitor/statistical quota

service.uniformity: fixed cyclic permutations, exact per-word periods; two-block frame, not a dense full pass
service.correctness: complete-word cleanup at fence, including allowed latch-fence hits, except delta_svc
service.timing: hard mask on every history; no unlimited retries

monitor.status: required conditional interface, not an identified flight instrument
monitor.missing_overflow_late_or_numeric_failure: alarm, no LOW; safe S, price charged to declared window/global quotas

own_ERR.role: first available flag enters or extends S; a single zero never releases S
own_ERR.true_count_cost_domination: each true flag on good execution charged to a removed word touch or one initial dirty word
own_ERR.under_and_over_count_contract_status: conditional; must be qualified for the full word and own latch

resources.price: expected occupied common-bus time through T, including after hidden failure

quiet_return_example.status: additional price-only contract, not inferred from fluence; initial portions of quiet intervals remain in the metric

accepted_input_sets.status: T72 D/four quotas/K0=0 retained; delta_exec=alpha_M=1e-6 ADDED explicitly. T73 monitor, total-load growth, 1ns paired calendar and full mark contract are additional assumptions; original T72 has no certified Poisson monitor.

issue82.old_always_S_and_fixed_tables: appendix E.5; not a new ERR-only exit or a realistic-monitor 1percent result

new_family.scope: Each environment/channel/budget tuple is a separate class. No common minimum across different classes.
new_family.monitor_unobserved_upper: b_U supplied independently; diagnostic b_U=bbar only as an explicit conditional assumption
new_family.H: least positive integer with J*(3/8)^H <= alpha_M; quota inherited unchanged within each budget set
new_family.k: largest certified nonnegative integer satisfying a_M*phi_lower*m_R_lower >= z*k+H; negative k_max means no LOW
new_family.lease: floor to timer grid of (H_l(vc)-H_l(qR))/rho_e; finite chosen lease if rho_e=0
new_family.service_c: least integer satisfying known joint upper and margin, including clock; no replacement of UNKNOWN upper by nominal
new_family.service_g: least integer passing resource tests for that c; a restricted subfamily, not all g

singleton_diagnostic.status: additional singleton/equal-load model; not physical MCU qualification

new_family.quiet_metric: Original nu<=b_nom<=bbar; reduced solar quiet upper only as a separately identified additional contract

return_contract.status: same additional price-only illustration as T73, not implied by fluence

new_family.claim: No realistic 1% result, grid minimum, or global optimum is claimed.

pilot.instructions: appendix E; first test short-service/direct budget before channel tuning; no new GOES processing or adaptive Monte Carlo.

monitor_price_conflict.conclusion: every safe k satisfies p_M>=1-exp(-H), since a_M*m_R<=mu_Q
monitor_price_conflict.scope: failure of the stated price certificate; no general impossibility claim

addressed_window_fractions.configuration_selection: one configuration before observing data; no free runtime multiple testing

return_edge_correction.mean_control_rate: C_X unchanged; use C_E for ERR-only

direct_fast_LOW_comparison.h_F_min: w+d+Delta+G+gmax+f+P_s, with timing margin and directed rounding
